newsitem.title: USA: Dow drops more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow drops more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 50 points in early trading on Tuesday as the market was stuck in a profit-taking mode for the second day following last week's series of record closes.
At 9:59 a.m. EDT, the index of 30 blue chip stocks was down 50.22 points at 7,721.87, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
